name: Miruka
source:
Milka is an extremely spiritual girl, who Art met during his test for becoming a knight. She's an innocent young girl who is afraid of no one.Art gave this girl her name.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031206133506fw_/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/new/2001/0126_card_of_distiny/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
